name: Safety Education : pedestrian safety
summary:
· Users can experience the characteristics of the Korean school zone and learn how to cross traffic lights and walk at night.

· crossing the street safely at an intersection
> Check the traffic lights and walking signals, and cross the road after the vehicle has stopped completely.
In VR, users experience how to check the correct walking signal and act.

· How to use the crosswalk
> Children pedestrians should walk with their hands raised when using the crosswalk.
